call_logging_exceptions: call a function and return an Outcome describing whether it returned a value or raised an exception
with_exceptions_logged: wrap a callable so that exceptions are logged and an Outcome is returned instead of raised
Outcome_Kind: use the Outcome.Kind enum to check if a call returned a value or raised an exception
create_Outcome_subclass: create a subclass of Outcome to represent custom call result types with kind, return_value, and exception
review_callable_util: review the callable_util module utilities for wrapping callables with exception logging and Outcome types
